judged_text: The shared `.form-horizontal` rules (bold labels, 350px inputs, 20px checkboxes) were deleted from their original broader parent selector and re-added only under `.groups, .badges`, so any other admin section that previously matched the old selector silently loses its form styling. Admin pages outside the groups and badges screens (whatever else fell under the original parent block) render with unstyled default-width inputs and labels after this change; the author had to add `.badges` explicitly, which is evidence the old block was serving sections beyond groups.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin_base.scss`, the shared `.form-horizontal` styling (bold `label`, `> div` top margins, `input/textarea/select` width 350px, checkbox width 20px) was removed from `section.details .form-horizontal` and reintroduced only under `.groups, .badges { .form-horizontal { ... } }`. This definitively narrows the scope of those styles: any `.form-horizontal` form still rendered under `section.details` but not within a `.groups` or `.badges` container will no longer receive the previous styling. The diff alone doesn’t prove which other admin pages rely on `section.details .form-horizontal`, but the scoping change is real and could cause UI regressions elsewhere.
